candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) on the inventory service, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and propagating ReadTimeouts up through order and gateway checkout, yielding 502s at the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show redis timeouts but no redis-side metrics/logs to confirm whether the fault is redis saturation, network, or inventory client config.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) cascading to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502s; gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 502s with p95 ~2.4s. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics or logs to confirm the timeout origin
